|game_text=Deploy on table. If your character or non-[Independent Starship] starship in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Rebels (except Jedi or [Permanent Weapon] characters) ignore location deployment restrictions (and "power -1") in their game text, apply their Endor deployment modifiers at any location, and are immune to [[Bad Feeling Have I]]. Your Interrupts that retrieve exactly 1 Force (except [[Corellian Retort (V){{!}}Corellian Retort]]) are not stacked on [[Do They Have A Code Clearance? (V){{!}}Do They Have A Code Clearance?]]. Cannot be canceled. (Immune to [[Alter]].)

* '''Original''' ([[Commando Training & •K'lor'slug]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet and the revised Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Deploy on table. If your character or non-[Independent Starship] starship in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Rebels (except Jedi or [Permanent Weapon] characters) ignore location deployment restrictions (and “power -1”) in their game text, apply their Endor deployment modifiers at any location, and are immune to Bad Feeling Have I. Your Interrupts that retrieve exactly 1 Force (except Corellian Retort) are not stacked on Do They Have A Code Clearance?. Cannot be canceled. [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref><ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=11 Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; revised copy, PDF dated 20 April 2010), page 11, slip 78. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=11 Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 23). Under the ruling of 11 November 2026 (every publication is a version), that copy is its own version, PC-E3 ([[Commando Training & •K'lor'slug (Errata 3)]]), and the current text.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=23, page 23. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=23 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “78” at the bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Commando Training & •K'lor'slug (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) spells “deployment” as “deploytment” (the list's straight single quotes around 'power -1' come from its HTML, which cannot hold double quotes, and are not counted as a change): “Deploy on table. If your character or non-[Independent Starship] starship in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Rebels (except Jedi or [Permanent Weapon] characters) ignore location deploytment restrictions (and 'power -1') in their game text, apply their Endor deployment modifiers at any location, and are immune to Bad Feeling Have I. Your Interrupts that retrieve exactly 1 Force (except Corellian Retort) are not stacked on Do They Have A Code Clearance?. Cannot be canceled. (Immune to Alter.)”.<ref name="cl-1261_79-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11</ref> The card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so this wording is a transcription the PC published, not a separately announced errata; it is listed because it was published.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-commandotraining&klorslug-pre.gif]]) prints the original release-sheet text ([[Commando Training & •K'lor'slug]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on table. If your character or non-[Independent Starship] starship in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Rebels (except Jedi or [Permanent Weapon] characters) ignore location deployment restrictions (and “power -1”) in their game text, apply their Endor deployment modifiers at any location, and are immune to Bad Feeling Have I. Your Interrupts that retrieve exactly 1 Force (except Corellian Retort) are not stacked on Do They Have A Code Clearance?. Cannot be canceled. [Immune to Alter]” The image is dated only by its upload to the Players Committee's server: the Apache listing of the Virtual6-Light card-image folder gives every file there the same time, 25 February 2013, 11:34<ref name="pcdir-Virtual6-Light">Players Committee server, [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034714/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/?C=M;O=A directory listing of cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/] sorted by date, as captured 18 August 2019 (Internet Archive)</ref>. That is a bulk upload date, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (ruling of 11 November 2026: what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). The PC card image prints the slip number “78” at the bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Commando Training & •K'lor'slug (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 23)<ref name="ml-ls" /> prints the original release-sheet text ([[Commando Training & •K'lor'slug]]) again, word for word: “Deploy on table. If your character or non-[Independent Starship] starship in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Rebels (except Jedi or [Permanent Weapon] characters) ignore location deployment restrictions (and “power -1”) in their game text, apply their Endor deployment modifiers at any location, and are immune to Bad Feeling Have I. Your Interrupts that retrieve exactly 1 Force (except Corellian Retort) are not stacked on Do They Have A Code Clearance?. Cannot be canceled. [Immune to Alter]” It is listed as a version because it was published (ruling of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat of an earlier text), and, as the latest dated text, it is the current text. Its image is the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1261-79-front-master.png]]). The Master List slip prints no slip number (the release-sheet slip and the PC card image print “78”). The release-sheet slip and the PC card image show only the Commando Training art; the Master List slip shows the two-card split art (Commando Training and K'lor'slug).
